name: deadfest-tools
description: Tooling for the Dead-Fest project: the Firestore rules tests and the desktop client.

scripts.test:rules: cd tools/rules-tests && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --config ../../firebase.json "node --test firestore.rules.test.js"
scripts.desktop: cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm start
scripts.desktop:dist: cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dist
